about: Results decided off the pitch, read on the competition's, the sports court's or (level 2) the press's site. The audits count them at their official score in table and Football-Data checks; our fixtures keep the score the provider gives (the played or the stopped score: bookmakers settle on it). Keyed by the provider's fixture id. 'official' for the Colombian cases is the 0-3 the provider's own table counts; the incidents are confirmed by the sources, the Dimayor resolutions themselves were not read.

decisions.match: 1. FC Union Berlin v VfL Bochum, Bundesliga 2024/25 match day 14, 14 Dec 2024
decisions.basis: DFB Sports Court, 9 Jan 2025: awarded 0-2 to Bochum (lighter thrown at Bochum's goalkeeper); appeal rejected by the DFB Federal Court, 28 Feb 2025

decisions.match: FC Nantes v Toulouse FC, Ligue 1 2025/26 match day 34, 17 May 2026
decisions.basis: abandoned after a pitch invasion; the LFP disciplinary commission (28 May 2026) homologated the 0-0 at the interruption (the provider: AWD 0-0)

decisions.match: Once Caldas v Alianza Petrolera, Primera A Apertura 2023 round 14, 18 Apr 2023
decisions.basis: pitch invasion at Palogrande, match not completed; Dimayor sanctions; the table counts 0-3 to Alianza

decisions.match: Patriotas v Deportivo Pereira, Primera A Apertura 2024 round 11, 10 Mar 2024
decisions.basis: stopped in the 63rd minute at 0-2 (pitch invasion); Dimayor ended it for lack of security and awarded 0-3 to Pereira

decisions.match: Deportivo Cali v Deportivo Pasto, Primera A Clausura 2024 round 8, 2 Sep 2024
decisions.basis: pitch invasion at Palmaseca; Dimayor sanction; the table counts 0-3 to Pasto

decisions.match: Atletico Nacional v Junior, Primera A Clausura 2024 round 10, 26 Sep 2024
decisions.basis: stopped at 2-0 after violence in the stands; Dimayor Resolution 080 of 2024 (2 Oct 2024) awarded the match to Junior (the table counts 0-3)
